notes.title: Version 1.3 Is Out
notes.content:
A new version of Thaumistry is out. If you still haven't finished the game, maybe now is the perfect time to get going!

Version 1.3 comes with:

[list]
[*][b]Full-screen support[/b]
You can now play the game in full-screen mode. In order to avoid excessively long lines of text, the maximum text width is now configurable in the options.

[*][b]Accessible text-mode version (Windows)[/b]
For visually impaired users who rely on screen readers and Braille displays, the Windows version can now be played in a text-mode window. This should provide full accessibility support for screen readers like NVDA and JAWS, or any other screen reader that supports text-mode windows.

[*][b]Accessibility improvements on macOS[/b]
The game should now be more accessible to visually impaired macOS users using VoiceOver.

[*][b]Stand-alone T3 file[/b]
We got quite a few requests to release a stand-alone T3 file that can be played using third-party TADS interpreters. The game is very closely tied to our own customized engine, but now we have a version that is able to run on vanilla TADS interpreters. You can find it inside the game's installation directory, aptly named "Thaumistry.t3".

Please note that the stand-alone version of the game lacks all of our custom engine functionality, including the in-game map, appearance, custom configuration options and auto saves.

[*]Numerous smaller enhancements and bug fixes.
[/list]

Please be aware that unlike the previous updates, this one [b]will break your existing saved games[/b]. If you have recently started playing the game but haven't finished it yet, you can opt to go back to version 1.2 in the game's Steam Properties. To do that, right-click on the game's entry in your Steam Library, select "Properties", and go to the "BETAS" tab. In the selection box, switch to "old_version_1.2" and Steam will download the previous version of the game files. You will still get the updated engine (including full-screen mode), but the text-mode version will not be available.

Have fun with the new version!
